auth_url.description: Keystone Identity API endpoint URL (e.g., https://keystone.example.com:5000/v3). Required.

project_name.description: Name of the OpenStack project (tenant) containing the Ironic node.

password.description: Password for the OpenStack user. Recommended to be stored in a secure credential store or environment.

domain_name.description: Domain name for the project (Keystone v3). Usually 'Default' unless using custom domains.

user_domain_name.description: Domain name of the user (Keystone v3).

project_domain_name.description: Domain name of the project (Keystone v3).

auth_type.description: Authentication method. Currently only 'password' is widely supported.

ironic_api_version.description: Ironic API version to use. Set to '1' for current stable (Pike+).

insecure.description: If true, skip SSL certificate verification (not recommended for production).

ca_cert.description: Absolute path to a CA certificate bundle for secure connections. Leave empty to use system trust store.

region_name.description: OpenStack region to use (e.g., 'RegionOne'). Leave blank if single-region or not applicable.

node.description: UUID (preferred) or name of the Ironic node to fence. Required.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for each OpenStack API call before timing out.

default_action.description: Fallback fencing action if not specified at invocation (on/off/reboot/status/list/monitor).

retry.description: Number of times to retry a failed operation (e.g., network glitch).

retry_max_delay.description: Maximum delay (seconds) between retries, used for exponential backoff.

extra_headers.description: Semicolon-separated list of HTTP headers to add to requests (e.g., 'X-Forwarded-For:10.0.0.1;X-Custom:abc').

secure.description: If false, disable SSL/TLS (only use for testing on trusted networks).

endpoint_type.description: Preferred Ironic service endpoint type (public/internal/admin), in order of precedence.
